title: AuditFindingReport
description: Structured output for cjs-design-auditor. The caller MUST pass this schema via Agent({schema: ...}) so the runtime forces validation. Without it, the agent may return narrative markdown.

auditedTarget.description: Absolute or repo-relative path of the component/route audited. e.g. 'src/components/layout/BenefSidebar/index.tsx' or '/jeune/tableau-de-bord'.

lotReference.description: Which Lot v3 was used as reference. e.g. 'Lot 2', 'Lot 3', 'Lot 14'.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the offending file

line.description: 1-based line number, or omit if not applicable (e.g. multi-line issue)

lotRef.description: Specific reference in design-guichet-v3/ or public/design-v3/. Format: '<file> L<start>-<end>' or '<HTML file>: <section>'. e.g. 'web-dashboard.jsx L60-66' or 'Lot 14 - Bibliotheque Composants.html: Button section'.

current.description: Verbatim snippet of what the implementation currently does

expected.description: Verbatim snippet of what the design specifies

missingFromDesign.description: Code present in the implementation but absent from the Lot reference (potential scope creep). Format: 1 line per item.

hors_perimetre_flag.description: Design elements visible in the Lot but not implemented yet, OR audit-truncated cases, OR Wave 7-figée components skipped. Format: 1 line per item.
